context.hint: Apply outbound request policy to the initial destination and every redirect.
context.surface: A discovery client derives a request URL and follows redirects to fetch a descriptor.
assumptions: A stub transport and controlled clock can observe the request and deadline contract.

review.invariant: Transport receives requests only after policy approval. Redirects and response waits have bounded execution.
review.verification: Test approved requests and approved relative redirects with a transport stub. Assert that a denied destination produces no transport call and that a stalled transport terminates.

source_observation.summary: The local fixture confirmed that destination validation and a request deadline addressed gaps while retaining the existing redirect bound.
